KPlugin.Description: Proton VPN control panel: status, connect/disconnect, country/server picking, world map, traffic monitor, and Kill Switch/NetShield/port forwarding/Always On/split tunneling via a Configure dialog. Ported from the Omarchy Quickshell widget (iamfitsum/omarchy-proton-vpn), driven by the official protonvpn CLI.
KPlugin.Name: Proton VPN
